name: PM-KISAN
summary: Income support for farming families who own land, paid straight into their bank account.
benefit_note: Paid as three equal instalments of ₹2,000.
how_to_apply: Go to the PM-KISAN portal and open Farmers Corner.
Choose New Farmer Registration and fill in your details.
Complete eKYC — this is mandatory and your application will not proceed without it.
Your state government checks your land records against what you entered.
Once approved, instalments are paid directly into your bank account.
common_pitfalls: eKYC is mandatory for every registered farmer. Applications sit unpaid until it is done.

curation_notes: DRAFT — not yet read by a human against the official page. Do not ship.
Benefit, eligibility and all six exclusions were taken from https://pmkisan.gov.in/ on 2026-08-09. Every source_quote is wording from that page.

NO LAND CEILING. The scheme covers 'all land holding farmer families'. An earlier 2-hectare limit is no longer in force. Do not add a land size rule without a quote from the official page saying otherwise.

TO CONFIRM: the documents list. The portal homepage does not state one. aadhaar_card and mobile_number follow from mandatory eKYC, land_record from the landholding requirement, bank_passbook from direct transfer — but confirm against the scheme guidelines before marking this verified.
TO CONFIRM: effort_level is MEDIUM on the assumption that a land record must be collected first. If registration works end to end online with no document collected beforehand, change it to EASY.
TO CONFIRM: how_to_apply steps are written from the portal's Farmers Corner links, not from walking through the form. Walk it once.
TO ADD: more common_pitfalls. Only the eKYC one has a source so far.
The official FAQ at https://pmkisan.gov.in/Documents/RevisedFAQ.pdf is a scanned PDF and could not be read automatically. Someone needs to open it by hand — it likely settles the documents list.

The scheme is a family entitlement: husband, wife and minor children count as one family. Our profile is per-adult, so two spouses filling separate profiles would each see this scheme. Worth a note on the card.
